title: GenerationRequest
description: One typed generative act the discovery cycle wants performed (propose a study, acquire/build a model, author tests, interpret a finding, resolve a decision, explain, visualize). The engine emits these as a pure projection over its already-derived cycle state; a filler (human skill or AI) outside the engine fills them, and the artifact is written back into the existing structured study/investigation fields. Strict at the top level: unknown fields are errors.

id.description: Stable, content-addressed on (kind, target, provenance) so the same frontier state re-emits the same request.

target.description: The investigation / study / claim / decision / finding id this act operates on.

produces.description: The contract the filled artifact must satisfy, e.g. study.yaml/v4, model_spec/v1, behavior_tests[], finding/v1, decision/v1, explanation/v1, viz_spec/v1.

rationale.description: Why the cycle wants this — carried from the frontier op / opportunity.

context.description: The typed slot payload + cycle state a filler needs (hypotheses to discriminate, competing predictions, parent study, catalog routes, evidence summary, ...).

value.description: Prioritization signal carried from the opportunity/candidate_action.

provenance.description: Which frontier op / opportunity produced the request.

gate.description: Resolved from the investigation's GateConfig at emit time.
